name: B10-0422/2025 (Renew) – United response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on a united response to recent Russian violations of the EU Member States’ airspace and critical infrastructure
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and asking the European Union and its member countries to act together against Russia. It asks them to protect their airspace better, invest in drones and anti-drone systems, tighten sanctions on Russian oil tankers, and keep supporting Ukraine. It also calls for a joint European defence effort and a stronger military presence along the EU's eastern border.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; these are requests to EU governments and institutions.
- **Who it affects:** EU member states, NATO partners, Ukraine, and Russian oil shipping.
- **What happens next:** EU governments and the Commission decide whether to act on these requests.
